posts.cooked:
I am currently facing an issue with accessing the VM for my BPT work. I have followed all the necessary steps to generate the SSH key and entered the public key in the VM manager site as instructed. However, I am encountering the error message that says “email not allowed” when trying to proceed.

I had previously attempted this process, and during that time, I received a “permission not granted” message when running the VM. When I try to follow the same steps, I am stuck with the current issue.

Please kindly assist me with resolving this problem and guide me on how to move forward with accessing the VM
